question: Bella Vado avocado oil company parent brand
markdown:
Bella Vado does not have a large corporate parent brand
. It is an independent, family-owned and operated company founded by Cid and Corinne da Silva in 2006, operating from their own organic avocado grove and processing facility in Valley Center, California.
